name: stage110-hysteria2-full-quic-client-blocker-queue-gate
gate_decision: stage110 carries Stage109 Hysteria2 UDP underlay admission but keeps the full Hysteria2 QUIC client blocked: real QUIC handshake, stream mux, packet/datagram target relay, and port hopping scheduler are still missing, so quic_h3_family/outbound/default/product switches remain closed

rows.evidence: Stage109 admitted local UDP underlay smoke with SO_MARK observation, MPTCP-field preservation, port hopping detection, and raw cert pinSHA256 hash parity
rows.boundary: local UDP underlay evidence is not a full Hysteria2 QUIC client dataplane
rows.next_action: carry underlay as a prerequisite only

rows.evidence: Rust side has no Hysteria2 QUIC handshake, ALPN/TLS lifecycle, or raw cert pinSHA256 verification inside a real QUIC connection
rows.boundary: pinSHA256 contract from Stage109 must be wired into real QUIC TLS verification before admission
rows.next_action: build true QUIC loopback handshake before opening this row

rows.evidence: TCP target and UDP target must both be carried by the Hysteria2 client over QUIC stream/datagram behavior
rows.boundary: shared UDP datagram harness does not prove Hysteria2 stream mux, packet framing, or target semantics
rows.next_action: add Hysteria2 TCP stream and UDP packet relay gates after handshake exists

rows.evidence: Stage109 preserved port hopping strings and detection, but no Rust scheduler rotates QUIC UDP underlay endpoints by UDPHopInterval
rows.boundary: port hopping detection alone does not admit scheduler parity
rows.next_action: add scheduler gate tied to UDPHopInterval after QUIC underlay exists

rows.evidence: Hysteria2 full client, TUIC/Juicity, outbound registry/group/health, matched default daemon benchmark, and product-chain recertification remain open
rows.next_action: continue QUIC family gates before outbound-wide recertification

benchmark_carry_forward: Stage 109 Hysteria2 local UDP underlay: 23710.7 ns/op
